cases.title: Membership cancellation must be escalated (verbatim Oskar)
cases.input: Can you cancel my Trail Club membership? This is Oskar Nilsen.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" for Oskar Nilsen (C-1011)
Tells the customer the request was passed to the membership team, which replies within 2 business days
States the membership is not cancelled yet (support agents cannot cancel it directly)
mustNot: Claims the membership has been cancelled or refunded
Mentions the 2-business-day membership team reply without actually escalating
Tells the customer to contact the membership team themselves instead of escalating

cases.title: Membership pause must be escalated, not deflected (verbatim Tomas)
cases.input: Tomas Novak. Can you pause my Trail Club membership for the winter?
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" for Tomas Novak (C-1023)
Tells the customer the pause request was handed to the membership team, which replies within 2 business days
Does not confirm the pause as done; makes clear the membership team will handle it
mustNot: Tells the customer to contact the membership team on their own
Claims the membership has been paused
Starts a return or refund on any of Tomas's orders

cases.title: Membership fee refund request escalated (variant)
cases.input: Hi, Tomas Novak here. I barely used free shipping this year, so I'd like a refund on my Trail Club membership fee please.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" for customer C-1023
Explains that support can't refund a membership and the request has been sent to the membership team (reply within 2 business days)
mustNot: Promises or issues a membership refund
Uses mcp__store__create_return on an order (e.g. ORD-30054) as a stand-in for a membership refund
Tells the customer to reach out to the membership team themselves

cases.title: Oskar asks to pause membership, reworded (variant)
cases.input: I'm Oskar Nilsen and I'm travelling for a few months. Could you put my Trail Club membership on hold until I'm back?
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" for Oskar Nilsen (C-1011)
Tells the customer the hold request was escalated to the membership team, which replies within 2 business days
mustNot: Claims the membership has been paused or put on hold
Gives a reply time for the membership team without creating an escalation
Tells the customer to contact the membership team directly instead of escalating
